Fabienne: (Said with a heavy French accent.) Bonjour my darling-eh, she is, how you say...very beautiful, no? She does not work....but....I think....ahhh, so what? Why should she? I mean....what would she do? (Hands tossed in the air, unknowingly.)
Faith:
Option A: Faith is older than 65 and lives for Friday night bingo.

Option B: Faith is younger than 40 and is a fast-moving girl with a large smile and who is eager to get moving. She leans into people she’s listening to and she doesn’t like sitting around once she’s made her mind up. (Note: if her parents named her that because of their own devout Christian beliefs, then we may have a problem Houston.)
Fallon: No, Fallon may not be the deepest sea out there but at least she gets to fly all over the world. She loves dressing up in shiny, colourful outfits so who knows, perhaps we'll see her in the Winter Olympics skiing or maybe driving V8’s for a production car racing team. She’s look awfully good sitting in a Porche.
Farah: Her bathroom is full of coastal themes that highlight what might have been had tragedy not struck as often as it did. Outside the bathroom she finds life somewhat daunting.
Farren: Farren is a selfie addict. Until she stops with all that ego bullshit we can’t tell you what she’s going to do with herself, but there’s no denying that she’s the captain of her own ship. When/if armageddon arrives, the hardships endured will pull her out of her deluded reverie faster than most and she’d survive just fine.
Fatima: Fatima is a loud and generous lover.
Fauziah: Fauziah isn’t one to spend hours and days sitting around complaining about the lack of things to do, no way. She has ambition, she has spunk and she gets shit done. She owes it to her family and her community, and don’t for a second think she’ll tolerate any misogynistic behaviour. Imagine that, a day when, say, Saudi Arabia, crowns a Queen Fauziah? Imagine what that could mean….
Fay:
(Sung to any decent rap melody)
"My name is Fay
If you don’t get out of my way
You’re gonna’ suffer
Great dismay.”
Faye: Judge. And a fair-minded one too. Her private life is actually a bubbling ball of social hilarity, although you’d never know it from seeing how she behaves in court.
Fee:
The standard handling rules apply to Fee as they do your cousin (Fi). 
Be prepared. 
Be prepared. 
Be prepared. 
Beyond that, hold on and good luck, and don’t ring us if something or someone catches on fire.
Felicia: If the girl in front of you presents as a shy, diminutive and secretive girl, you're not looking at Felicia. End of story.
Felicity: The Stalker. Felicity can be very sexy but she’s definitely quite crazy.
Fenella: Fenella approaches most tasks like a long-limbed spider who has the capacity to think about (and handle) plenty of objects and ideas at any given moment. She is therefore very knowledgeable and she enjoys applying that knowledge where she sees fit. Pure playfulness may be a little beyond her brain to compute the usefulness of, but if she can direct her mind to sexual play and get all her attention focussed in the one place, she can have an orgasm that vibrates the very fabric of space-time around her.
Fergie: Fergie is not easily missed or forgotten. Interestingly, she is exactly one part Fi and one part Felicity, and that makes her quirky and artistic (whether she has talent or not), and sexy, and in your face if she feels like it, and she’s fabulous in bed - if not slightly unorthodox.
Fern: No, Fern isn't the gun powder, she's more like the calming  balm of the linseed oil that is rubbed into the smooth, old stock of a very expensive rifle worth tens of thousands of dollars. She smells great, she has patience and after spending time in her company, after a while all you want to do curl up against her and fall asleep.
Fi: “Get out of my way!” she barks, heading for the bar/party/car keys/front of the queue/cupboard/fridge/bedroom/spa/diving platform/dance floor/anything.
Fi-Fi: Christ or mighty, where do you start? Well, firstly, she ain't shy and she doesn't shy away from a confrontation either, so don't ask her if she'd like a pretend punch up - there'll be nothing pretend about it, mostly coz' she hates to lose. Secondly, she loves sex and she's generally good at it, although she's usually a wee bit more timid in the bedroom than she is in real life, which is probably a relief. Why is that? I've no idea. Thirdly, if you piss her off, she'll just cut you out of her life with not so much as a second thought. And rightly so. In a past life Fi-Fi was a World War 1 fighter pilot in a biplane, and sometimes, after she ran out of ammo', she was forced to shoot at her opponents in the sky with her pistol.
Fidelma: I wonder if she was ever attached to the fashion industry? She is definitely big on design and large scale events. Families rock her boat and she insists her kids give her grandchildren, which means her presence for certain people is always a blessing and a curse.
Fiefield:
Yep, we know, it’s a weird name but by George it’s done her proud. Fiefield is not only a woman, a rather beautiful and optimistic woman, actually, but she is fiercely independent and capable. Sensual too. Indeed, you say her name and sit up, both startled and delighted all at once at the sound of such a title on a human. This reaction has given her space and nous and self-belief. Fiefield is a bloody legend and she doesn’t care what you make of her. Like a few others out there, the only sadness (which his ours, not hers) is that there are just incredibly few Fiefields in the wild.
In fact, if you meet one can you give us a tingle?
Thanks.
Finella:
Trashy? Finella? No way Hosay. Finella is by and large the epitome of style and subtlety. Did she study Arts at university, or was it Law, or was it both? Well-read from a little girl, by the time she travelled the world she’d already spent a few hours in her head at la Fontana de Trevi, the Eiffel Tower and Times Square. She saw them all in the flesh eventually and felt a gentle kind of delight, because she knows you can’t know a person or a place until you smell them. 
Finella is a lovely deep sea worth taking the time to get to know well, and to love if you get the chance, and she is almost certainly not a natural blonde.
Finn: Finn will take off on her own for weeks, months and sometimes years, travelling to all parts of the world, engaging with as many different peoples as she can. It's her way of both giving and receiving and she's way more energetic than her male counterpart.
Fiona: There are no in-betweens with Fiona. Either she’s plain and a bit dull, or she is incredibly sexy, ambitious, charismatic and occasionally stressed. Regardless of which one she is, however, Fiona would go to the hairdresser every day if she could. Outside her bad hair days – of which there are at least five every week – she’s surprisingly chilled out.
Fionola: No, Fionola is not a grand instrument, although she did play the piano for a while. She is, in fact, a very happy and dedicated mine-site manager. She wears a hard hat everywhere she goes and the bright orange outfit kind of matches her bright red hair. Despite the smile, her advice is to be taken seriously, you got that?
Fiorella: Italiana? No? Oh well, she’s still molto sexy and a splendid actress. Boys drool and she always get large discounts at hotels/shops etc, and she rarely pays for a drink. She terrifies passengers with her driving however, even though she hasn’t crashed badly yet. She looks distracted, I know, but fear not, she’s on the case.
Fish: Possibly Swiss, Fish is clean living and clean thinking, if not on the surface then definitely at her core. And, naturally, she’s great in, on and under the water.
Fitzy: Frisky. Despite her bull-approach in the professional arena Fitzy is a surprisingly sensitive soul. Like trillions of beings throughout the universe, all she really wants to do is hang out with the one she loves, meet with her friends, and contemplate what she might get up to tomorrow. Is that so much to ask?
Fleur: It’s not possible for anyone to be as soft and as perfect as the sound of her name, and so it is. Fleur might be the first drops of rain from the storm, she might be the wayward personality with delusions of grandeur, and she might be the hard-hitting journo’. Who knows? This girl is anything but normal and she does non-normalness very well.
Flick: The sensuous and intelligent blonde who is rollicking good fun. Like any half-decent Bower Bird, she is attracted to all bright and shiny metal objects; bracelets, brass knuckles, 9mm nickel-plated pistols, wedding rings, stainless steel shackles, handcuffs….you name it. Friends and lovers, have you got a padlock?
Fliss: Fliss is wonderful. Her smile does damage she has no idea about, and every time she turns around she subconsciously expects there to be some kind of incredible life discovery in front of her. Imagine living like that every day? No wonder she seems happy and relaxed all the time. Her sour moods, on the rare occasion when they do arrive, therefore tend to be funny rather than catastrophic.
Flo: “Oh well,” she drones slowly, squinting into the blazing sun. “We’ve got a drought on now, but we get floods out here too, mate. Anyway, what can you do? That’s life in the bush for ya, hey.”
Florence: Florence is 92 yrs old and lives in a small country town that's 300 miles from the nearest city. If everyone knew what she knew and lived as simply as she did, peace on Earth would become a rapid and remarkable reality.
Florencia: Florencia can afford a team of well-paid gardeners to tend her expansive flower beds, but she loves getting out there and shovelling shit for the greater good. The personal satisfaction she receives is always worth the hard work.
Forrest: Forrest is the real deal - as wise as the hills she sits on, as proud as she needs to be, diverse and quirky down to her roots and she helps and urges everything and everyone around her with a smile.
Foxy: She almost gives Lainey a run for her money in terms of a laid-back nature, but Foxy has that spark of charisma that allows her to pack a punch. And yes, she’s a wonderful flirt.
Fran: Often caught in the mire of life’s chores, she’s a more generous person than most. Aside from being gifted with special psychic powers did you know that in her cupboard are heaps of sexy suspenders?
Franca: Picture this: It's summer, night time, and  you're skinny dipping near some cliffs in the Greek islands. You're with friends, the water is clear and life doesn't get much better. Suddenly you hear an almighty screech from up above, near the cliff face! Look out! HERE COMES FRANCA!
Francelle: Tired of life’s drudgery, Francelle would love to be transported back in time to a Monet painting. Her idea of heaven, right now, is to recline in a small wooden boat afloat on a calm pond which is being oared by a Frenchman in a beret, and whose shirt is half-unbottoned. At her feet is a basket containing wine, cheese, a baguette, a knife and corkscrew. And a blanket, which she hopes to employ a little later.  ;)
Frances: Frances enjoys wearing big black boots with steel caps. She clomps around the house making lots of noise, which makes up for her quiet nature, unless she’s hungry of course, in which case she clomps loudly and with genuine purpose.
Francesca: A wonderful woman who is full of life, love, compassion and humour. She has more complications during her pregnancy and subsequent labour than any other woman, however, and if she can survive all of those then she’ll have a big and wonderful family. We wish her well.
Francine: Even when she's smitten Francine keeps her cool. She never shirks her responsibilities and a superior intellect means that she accomplishes most things in her life with relative ease. She's big on surprises, and no, we’re not being sarcastic.
Frankie:
Frankie is enthusiastic. For example, having just taken up surfing in Western Australia only a matter of months ago and loving it, the news of 9 people being eaten by great white sharks in the last four weeks within two miles of her favourite spot deosn't enter her head.
"Why would they bother me?" she says. "I'm only little."
The sun is setting and yet there she is, paddling out on her own.
There's nothing little about Frankie, trust me.
Fraser: Like a very cute and capable soccer referee who has a dozen players in front of her face yelling and screaming their displeasure at a decision that went against them, Fraser remains cool and unflustered amid the noise and the anger. Little do they don't know that she was a Navy Seal before she got into umpiring sport. These idiots don't know what anger is, she's thinking, which is why she's smiling at their on-field antics.
Freda: Freda loves her boots and she likes striding out of the house on a winter's day, under a jacket and scarf, feeling like she looks the goods. She likes how her bum is looking at the moment and, though she'd never admit it, that serious look on her face is all bluff. She gets her car cleaned regularly.
Freddy: The playful messenger who darts in and out of spaces, and who is nearly incapable of being overcome with sadness, aside from the regular romantic dramas she seems to attract. Freddy is a dish. Indeed, some advice: Freddy, most of them are drop-kicks so be patient. Greatness is a-coming. Make no mistake. Management. x
Freya: Freya rhymes with ‘Easy does it’, but she grew out of that. As a fashion designer of some note, these days she is extravagant and laid-back. Indeed, nothing isn’t impossible for this persona.
Frida: Sensual and affectionate, Frida is occasionally overly sensitive.
Frith: Folks, fear not. Frith’s fown is rarely, if ever, intended as a sign of frustration or pain. Frith is just intensely curious and she’s here to help, end of story.
Frog: Frog wears her name like one of those English pubs that has a name like, The Pork Horn and Miss Dingleberry’s Underpants. Lovely girl. Nice pub.
Fulvia: It's not that you can't take her anywhere - with a laugh that loud and contagious how could you leave her at home? - but if she's at a swank dinner with the in-crowd at San Diego’s finest restaurant, and she spills some syrup off her spoon during desert, don't think she wont lick her hands and fingers clean, right at the table. Why waste all that beautiful sauce, she's tell you, and the universe loves her fot it. Peer group pressure is for sheep, not for this vixen.
Fynn: Funky Fynn is definitely funny, as well as adaptable and proactive. She’s far better outdoors than in and as a tomboy of sorts, she’s intrigued all the boys for an awfully long time and she always will. Clunky in romance, however. She’d make a fantastic park ranger or zoo keeper.
